adds.title: Supreme Federal Court ruling of 1 March 2018 on name and sex change
adds.summary: On 1 March 2018 in ADI 4275 the Federal Supreme Court held that the right to equality without discrimination encompasses gender identity and expression as a manifestation of personality that the State must recognize, and therefore authorized change of name and gender on the civil registry without sex-reassignment surgery or judicial authorization.

adds.title: Statement by Special Secretary of Culture Mario Frias - August 2021
adds.summary: In August 2021, Rio Grande do Sul's Secretariat of Culture maintained a women's bathroom designated as inclusive of trans women and travestis, which federal Special Secretary of Culture Mario Frias publicly criticized.

adds.title: Rio Grande do Sul Justice provision of 22 April 2022 on non-binary rectification
adds.summary: On 22 April 2022 the Rio Grande do Sul judiciary authorized non-binary people to change first name and gender directly in civil registry offices in RS.

adds.title: Porto Alegre court order of 28 September 2025 - bar restroom denial case
adds.summary: In Porto Alegre on 28 September 2025 a court condemned a bar for preventing a trans man from using the men's restroom.

adds.title: Appellate court decision of 28 May 2026 overturning restroom case
adds.summary: On 28 May 2026 in Rio Grande do Sul, the judiciary acquitted a nightclub of a transfobia allegation.
